description: opensync-lab pods: OpenSync 6.6.1.0 on mac80211_hwsim (opensync-platform-cfg80211). The fronthaul row is what the lab NOC creates (local-noc mesh.py pod_step); vif_radio_idx 1 as it writes it, since index 2 left hostapd unable to add the BSS. btm and rrm are on (hostapd bss_transition, rrm_neighbor_report): an EasyMesh agent steers its clients with BTM requests. Extra slots are the VIFs the platform creates per radio (52_owm_prep.sh). The uplink station is the 5 GHz backhaul station the pod bootstrap creates (vif_radio_idx 0).
